title: Obtain the download URL for MMM data
content_data:
Use this endpoint to obtain the download URL for Media Mix Modeling (MMM) data. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/mmm/api/download/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | mmm_request_id {Required} | string | Unique identifier for the MMM data request.

  • To create an MMM data request and obtain the data request ID, use [/mmm/api/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-an-mmm-data-request/v1.3).
  • To retrieve historical MMM data requests, including data request IDs, use [/mmm/api/history/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-the-mmm-data-request-history/v1.3).
| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/mmm/api/download/?mmm_request_id={{mmm_request_id}}' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| download_url| string | A URL to download the compressed CSV file for MMM data.

Validity period: seven days.
Once the URL expires, you need to call [/mmm/api/download/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/obtain-the-download-url-for-mmm-data/v1.3) to obtain a new URL.

To learn about the available MMM data fields, see [MMM templated data schema](https://bytedance.sg.larkoffice.com/sheets/YDwDsKe5whGQWdtaZVrlD9BHgIc). | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "download_url": "{{download_url}}" } } (/code) ```
